pages.title: Grades
pages.text: Sometimes what comes through is altered: Rifted, Deep-Rifted, Void-Rifted. Stronger, harder to kill, and carrying affixes of the rift.$(br2)Night helps the odds, a new moon more, the deep dark most. Rift residue given with the lure helps too.

pages.title: Residue and Prisms
pages.text: An altered creature slain leaves $(item)rift residue$(). Releasing a familiar gives more. Residue corrupts a familiar one grade further, though one try in four cracks its ring for half an hour instead.$(br2)A $(item)void prism$() buys a filter, to keep only the affixes I want.
